chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Casting the pebbles at the Jamarat is a ذخْر (stored provision) for the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.الْجِمَارِ: the ritual stone-pillars of the hajj at which pebbles are cast
key_terms.الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and Judgment
key_terms.ذُخْرٌ: a stored provision or treasure kept for future benefit
key_terms.رَمْيُ: the act of casting or throwing

ai.seo_question: How does casting the pebbles at the Jamarat benefit a believer on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the ritual of casting pebbles at the Jamarat during hajj carries lasting spiritual benefit beyond the immediate act of worship. It emphasizes that deeds performed in obedience to Allah become a stored provision for the believer on the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2195 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Casting the pebbles at the Jamarat is a provision for the Day of Judgment."
